title: Appointments, billing and cancelling
body: Your first visit is a video appointment with a nurse and a provider. The nurse gathers background, then the provider decides whether treatment is appropriate for you.
You are not charged for treatment until a provider approves you and you activate your subscription.
Follow-up visits are shorter and happen with a provider. You book them yourself.
You can pause or cancel your subscription at any time by contacting the Care Team.
